cases.name: Muriel La’Donna Emerson
cases.about: She was a former probation officer.
cases.narrative:
Medical examiners later determined she had been stabbed 42 times, including in the heart and lungs, and that the attack was committed with such force, one of the knives he used broke.

Christian told detectives he started having homicidal thoughts hours before he stabbed Emerson to death. He told them he grabbed a knife and went into the kitchen. When Emerson tried to run, the first knife broke. Christian said he simply grabbed another knife and finished the job.

He also told cops he took a picture of her bloodied body before draping a blanket over it.
